items.title: Ike Robertson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: Yeah, Earl was pretty good trombone player. In fact, all of them Humphreys is pretty good.

ctx.x: It was Earl, uh, Humphrey. Oh yeah. Did you know him? Yeah, Earl Humphrey was. Well, Earl was pretty good too.
Yeah, Earl was pretty good trombone player. In fact, all of them Humphreys is pretty good. Yeah, I guess they're all pretty good.

Mm-hmm. I heard a story one time, uh, uh, that, uh, when, uh, when Chris was, uh, getting tired and wanted to go home, he'd play a, he'd play a very low down blues. Mm-hmm. And that made it sort of break the place up. Did he ever do that?
